timeline.title: Google 完善 Gemini 4 家族：轻快执行主力「Hydrogen（氢）」与重度科研旗舰「Carbon（碳）」
timeline.title_en: Google rounds out Gemini 4 family: fast execution Hydrogen & heavy-research Carbon
timeline.what_it_does: Hydrogen 负责高频自动化执行与子 Agent 并发，Carbon 专攻长周期科研难题，与最新 Neon 组成高中低三档完整梯队。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Hydrogen powers fast agent execution while Carbon tackles long-horizon research, flanking the new Gemini 4 Neon.
timeline.who_cares: 开发者、投研分析师、多模态内容创作者
timeline.limitations: Google AI Studio 免费档存在每分钟/每日调用限额，重度业务需付费配额。
timeline.limitations_en: Free AI Studio tier has strict per-minute/daily quotas.

timeline.title: OpenAI 推出「GPT-6.2 Astra」与高性价比「GPT-6.2 Sol」，同步发布安全专版 GPT-6 Cyber
timeline.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra, balanced GPT-6.2 Sol & enterprise GPT-6 Cyber
timeline.what_it_does: Astra 瞄准顶尖复杂推理与多模态任务，Sol 主打日常高性价比调用，Cyber 与 Astra for Law 6.2 则切入企业网络安全与法律垂直场景。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Astra leads frontier multimodal reasoning, Sol balances cost/speed, and Cyber/Law variants serve regulated enterprise workflows.
timeline.who_cares: 企业开发者、安全与法律团队、ChatGPT 重度用户
timeline.limitations: 全闭源计费；GPT-6 Cyber 仅面向通过合规审批的安全组织开放。
timeline.limitations_en: Closed commercial API; GPT-6 Cyber restricted to vetted security organizations.

timeline.title: OpenAI 联手 AMD 用大模型加速下一代芯片设计，并持续迭代图像多模态
timeline.title_en: OpenAI partners with AMD on LLM-accelerated chip design alongside multimodal updates
timeline.what_it_does: 用 AI 自动辅助芯片验证和底层架构优化，缩短新算力卡上市周期并拉低未来 AI 推理算力成本。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Uses LLMs to speed up hardware design verification and reduce future AI inference costs.
timeline.who_cares: 芯片产业链观察者与 AI 行业从业者
timeline.limitations: 属中长期底层算力合作，短期内不会立刻体现在普通聊天产品界面上。
timeline.limitations_en: Medium-to-long-term R&D milestone without immediate consumer UI changes.

timeline.title: 千问上线下一代旗舰预览版「Qwen4-Max-Preview」
timeline.title_en: Alibaba Qwen launches next-gen flagship Qwen4-Max-Preview
timeline.what_it_does: 中文语境理解、复杂数学逻辑推理与工具调用全面升级，适合国内企业和个人平替昂贵海外模型做知识库与 Agent 办公。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Upgraded bilingual reasoning, math, and tool-use built for enterprise agents and knowledge bases.
timeline.who_cares: 国内开发者、企业团队、高频办公人群
timeline.limitations: 目前以阿里云云端 API 预览为主，完整开源及正式计费待公布。
timeline.limitations_en: Currently cloud API preview; full GA pricing and open-weight plans pending.

timeline.title: DeepSeek 持续迭代「DeepSeek V4-Pro」与低延迟 Flash 优化，领跑 OpenRouter 开发者调用量
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek iterates on DeepSeek V4-Pro MoE & low-latency Flash, leading OpenRouter dev traffic
timeline.what_it_does: 以极低推理单价与稀疏 MoE 架构提供接近海外闭源旗舰的代码与数学能力，非常适合高并发 Agent、批处理翻译和中小团队降本替代。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Ultra-low-cost MoE reasoning and coding model dominating high-volume developer workloads and budget-friendly agent pipelines.
timeline.who_cares: 独立开发者、创业公司、高频 API 调用业务
timeline.limitations: 高峰时段官方直连偶有排队，可通过多云/开源自建分流。
timeline.limitations_en: Official endpoint may queue during peak hours; easily routed via open weights or cloud mirrors.

timeline.title: Kimi 开放「Kimi K3.1 Pro」完整权重，强化超长文档与搜索 Agent 能力
timeline.title_en: Moonshot AI opens full weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro with agentic search
timeline.what_it_does: 擅长一次性通读几十万字财报/合同/论文并多轮联网深挖，开放完整权重让企业和研究者可以在私有内网部署“完全不泄密的私人 Kimi”。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Handles massive financial/legal documents and multi-step web research; open weights allow private on-premise deployment.
timeline.who_cares: 投研、法律、学术研究及需要数据保密的企业
timeline.limitations: 满血权重本地运行需要多卡服务器，普通用户建议用云端版或量化版。
timeline.limitations_en: Full weights need multi-GPU servers; consumers should use hosted API or quantized builds.
